label: Fires at D1 when the last two trials reached S1 and the earlier one went unrewarded.
terms: (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == S1) * (tv("state", -3) == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == S1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * (tv("state", -2) == S2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2)
explanation: Sparse D1-only feature (zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude is driven by a two-trial conjunction: the trial before last reached S1 and was NOT rewarded, and the last trial also reached S1 again (activation ~1-2 vs ~0 otherwise). Either half alone does little (prev S1 x t-2 S1 and prev S1 x t-2 unrewarded as separate terms: dev 0.19), so the conjunction is the crux. In the short form, tv(state,-2)+tv(reward,-2)==1 is an integer-constant encoding of the t-2 trial being S1 unrewarded (state 1, reward 0; the only other match, S2 with penalty, is rare), used because the short form allows at most 3 factors; a small negative offset after S2 is the second term. The free fit adds: stronger when t-3 was also S1, weaker when the last S1 visit came via a2 (rare) or was rewarded; belief_lo adds nothing. Hidden good state, future reward and upcoming choice do not matter. Residual misses are windows that start mid-streak, where the S1-unrewarded history lies before the window (unobservable here).

issues: The claims hold up. The core conjunction alone, (D1)*(prev_state==S1)*(t-2 S1 unrewarded), scores 0.453 test R^2 beyond timing. Its halves are much weaker: prev S1 x t-2 unrewarded scores 0.152 and prev S1 x t-2 S1 scores 0.074.
The second term (the negative offset after S2) adds only 0.015 on test (0.453 to 0.468). The label leaves it out, but that is a minor omission because the feature is about 0 there anyway.

Each extra refinement (t-3 S1 unrewarded, prev rewarded, a general prev-S1 offset, prev S1 x t-2 S1 rewarded) scored lower on test (about 0.455-0.458), not higher. So no better short form was found, and the free-fit refinements are small.

Misses: the worst windows are almost all at the window start, where the t-2 trial lies outside the 5-trial window. This matches the claimed explanation and the tool cannot fix it. One smaller real miss: weak firing (about 0.7-0.8) after S1 visits where the earlier S1 visit was rewarded (e.g. t44 and t19 in the misses output). The largest systematic phase x previous-trial residuals are small: D1 after a1 S1 u +0.06, D1 after a2 S1 r -0.075.
